import sys
from datetime import datetime

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

from eligibility import Member, can_post, posting_summary, visible_authors

now = datetime(2026, 11, 14, 12, 0)
old = datetime(2026, 1, 1)
members = [
    Member("ada", True, False, True, old),
    Member("bob", False, False, True, old),
    Member("cy", True, True, True, old),
    Member("dee", True, False, False, old),
    Member("eve", True, False, True, datetime(2026, 11, 10)),
    Member("fay", True, False, True, old, warnings=3),
    Member("gus", True, False, True, datetime(2026, 11, 7, 11, 59), warnings=2),
]
print([(m.name, can_post(m, now)) for m in members])
print(visible_authors(members, now))
print(posting_summary(members, now), "|", posting_summary([], now))


class Partial:
    is_active = False


print(can_post(Partial(), now), visible_authors([Partial()], now), posting_summary([Partial()], now))
print("ok")
